summary: Video upscale ships twice - the plugin landed in MPI-579, the Flow Library half is this card. Reuses the existing workflow, op and injector; /mpi-add-flow, not /mpi-add-model.
Flow half of the LTX Video upscaler. Op, workflow and injector all exist from MPI-579 - this card adds a FlowDef plus its test case, reusing the plugin fields verbatim.

note: FlowDef + title test shipped: 631 node tests, eslint clean, release:check pass, and a live isolated instance proves the tile, availability on ltx-23-balanced alone, all three fields mounting Primitives, UI 0.5/0 -> sigma 0.675 schedule + cfg 1, and the empty-run guard. Validating: a real run, the two graphics, the VRAM-cap call and the dev gate are Fabio's.

Fabio ran an upscale himself and left the pair in Downloads/video upscale (ref2v_ms_005.mp4 source, ltxVideoUpscale_002.mp4 result) - the graphics material for /mpi-flow-graphics. Card stays validating: graphics, the VRAM-cap call and the dev-gate call are still open, and the compare widget he asked for is now MPI-585.

Cross-card pointer added by the MPI-504 session (Fabio, 2026-08-20): the graphics for BOTH flows are ONE session - this card's flow-ltx-upscale.webp/.mp4 and MPI-504's flow-character-sheet.webp + hero clip. Written into this card's checklist under the existing graphics item, since a pickup reads the checklist and not the event log. No other change to this card; it stays in validating and is otherwise untouched by that session.

Closed by Fabio, 2026-08-20. The two open calls are both answered and neither becomes a card: the VRAM ceiling gets NO cap - his words, "user hits OOM, he knows his graphics card can't handle it, it's that simple" - and the dev gate comes off Flows entirely under MPI-589, so it is no longer this card's question. Graphics shipped in d6a622c3 (flow-ltx-upscale.webp + .mp4, live-verified). The real run through the Flow happened: seven of them in the cowboys project.
